en: An old monochrome postcard showing a rural valley landscape with dense trees and a few scattered houses or farm buildings nestled among the hills. At the top there is printed text in German and Latvian. Additional vertical text in Russian is printed along the left margin, which includes a date and the name of a photographer in Riga. The overall design and typography are characteristic of early 20th‑century picture postcards.
